hard_exclusion_definitions.work_authorisation: The advertisement mandates citizenship, permanent residency, an existing clearance, or another work-authorisation status that the candidate snapshot does not establish.
hard_exclusion_definitions.mandatory_credential: The advertisement mandates a licence, certification, clearance, or other credential that the candidate snapshot does not establish.
hard_exclusion_definitions.location_schedule: A mandatory location, attendance, schedule, or employment-type condition conflicts with the frozen track and candidate availability.
hard_exclusion_definitions.mandatory_experience_or_qualification: A clearly mandatory experience, qualification, or knowledge requirement is confirmed not met by the candidate snapshot.
hard_exclusion_definitions.track_scope: The role is outside the full-time early-career IT track, is sales-dominated, primarily manual, suspicious, unpaid, identity-harvesting, or defence-related.
